name: Rikka
source:
Although he looks young, he is an adult. He is cheerful and loves to move around. He's good at studying but hates it. He is the second son of the Beyondaris family, but is unaware of it and takes it lightly.

[Translated from [url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/05blind_3.html]official website[/url]]
